preconditions.description: Number of vertices in the initial complete graph is between 1 and 10^6.
Number of edges in Alice's graph is between 0 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge in Alice's graph connects two distinct vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The output is the total number of triangles in both Alice's and Bob's graphs.
